name: MaidsnBlack
description: Tech-driven residential and Airbnb cleaning service for DC / Maryland / Virginia. Online "book in 60 seconds" pricing by bedrooms/bathrooms, cleaners in teams of two, weekly / bi-weekly / monthly recurring plans, and a contractor-recruiting portal (mib.moppworks.com) offering scheduling, payments and customer management to cleaners. Founded Feb 2013, US. TrustMRR pricing model: "Contact for Quote".

mentions.evidence: MRR $0 / 0 seat subscriptions (per-job billing), ~$105,289 L30, ~$22,872,928 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 5, 2026 ~10:03 Warsaw (08:03 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Don't run cleaners yourself. Sell the "book in 60s + dispatch + charge after service" stack to one-city cleaning operators (white-label booking widget + contractor payouts), or run the playbook in one metro where nobody does instant online pricing.

whyItPrints: Local service plus thin software, no AI. Recurring cleans become habit revenue, while the booking + dispatch + auto-charge stack lets it run like a marketplace. 13 years of Stripe history adds up to ~$22.9M. Card-on-file, charged after service, is the whole moat.
